summary: Kiniksa Pharmaceuticals filed an 8-K regarding a deed of waiver with Baker Bros. Advisors LP, on behalf of certain shareholders. The deed waives the shareholders' conversion rights for Class A1/B1 shares into Class A/B shares if such conversion would result in beneficial ownership exceeding 49.9% of the company's outstanding voting rights. The waiver requires a 75% shareholder vote to amend, terminate, or waive. This is a governance/ownership restriction, not a capital markets event or restructuring. What to watch: any future attempts to modify the ownership cap or change in control dynamics.
